repo.lib.jfn.ac.lk — Design of Small Horizontal Axis Wind Turbine for Low Wind Speed Rural Applications — http://repo.lib.jfn.ac.lk/xmlui/handle/123456789/2319
(opened by the member, not cited)
Aero-Rotor Lead said about it: I read the Design of Small Horizontal Axis Wind Turbine for Low Wind Speed Rural Applications (E3) which found the SD7080 airfoil best with maximum lift-to-drag ratio 46.3 and optimum Cp 0.34 at TSR 6, and I apply it in the SD7080 rotor (C2); with 40 cm diameter the available wind power (E9) 9.62 W at 5 m/s and (E10) 102 W at 11 m/s give shaft power (E11) 3.27 W at 5 m/s and (E12) 34.7 W at 11 m/s, about a phone charger, which is plausible for start-up at 5 m/s.
Aero-Rotor Lead said about it: The same TSR 6 gives rotor speed (E14) 1.43e+03 RPM at 5 m/s and (E13) 3.15e+03 RPM at 11 m/s for direct-drive matching (C4), while wind dynamic load scale (E15) 37.3 N at 22 m/s is about 3.80 kg weight, easily carried to the post but requiring stall limiting; I read (E3) shows soft stall in 4 to 9 deg angle range and (E2) shows unloaded overspeed near 4300 RPM, so I add soft-stall sections (C7) to cap thrust and speed.
